Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Admission rule
Admit only when every input below is present/clear. Connector-authentication is separate from Helio workspace-admin proof; connector choice is not an eligibility proxy. No passwords, tokens, API keys, or other secrets are requested or collected. No and Not sure connector answers remain pending and route to assistance before workspace admission; a definite Yes continues through the other checks.

Checklist inputs
I1. Fewer than 50 seats.
I2. Accepted Helio workspace-admin proof.
I3. No agency or external-admin circumstance.
I4. Administrative ownership resolved.
I5. Deployment is simple enough for standard self-serve setup.
I6. Expected first-week integration fits the supported product path.
I7. Entitlement is current and compatible with the offered path.
I8. Standard billing is sufficient; no manual billing exception is required.
I9. No import or migration assistance is required.
I10. Requested permissions are supported.
I11. Connector-access answer is Yes: the applicant can authenticate the selected supported connector account in the first week. This field is separate from I2.

Regression cases
A0 — admitted baseline
All inputs I1–I11 are present/clear. Result: admitted public self-serve path. Ordinary setup help remains admitted setup support when the administrator is verified and the integration is supported.

R1 — non-admitted: I1 only
I1 fails: 50 or more seats. I2–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R2 — non-admitted: I2 only
I2 fails: accepted Helio workspace-admin proof is absent or insufficient. I1 and I3–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R3 — non-admitted: I3 only
I3 fails: agency or external-admin circumstance is present. I1–I2 and I4–I11 are present/clear. Result: routed out under the existing external-authority boundary; not admitted.

R4 — non-admitted: I4 only
I4 fails: administrative ownership remains unresolved. I1–I3 and I5–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R5 — non-admitted: I5 only
I5 fails: deployment is not simple enough for standard self-serve setup. I1–I4 and I6–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R6 — non-admitted: I6 only
I6 fails: expected first-week integration does not fit the supported product path. I1–I5 and I7–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R7 — non-admitted: I7 only
I7 fails: entitlement is missing, stale, or incompatible. I1–I6 and I8–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R8 — non-admitted: I8 only
I8 fails: manual billing or another unsupported billing arrangement is required. I1–I7 and I9–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R9 — non-admitted: I9 only
I9 fails: import or migration assistance is required. I1–I8 and I10–I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R10 — non-admitted: I10 only
I10 fails: requested permissions are unsupported. I1–I9 and I11 are present/clear. Result: refused/routed out; not admitted.

R11 — non-admitted: I11 only
I11 fails: connector-access answer is No or Not sure. I1–I10 are present/clear. Result: pending and routed to Customer Success assistance before workspace admission; connection prompts are suppressed while connector-access proof is pending; not admitted in this state.

Lineage and interpretation
The later connector-access input was added on 2024-04-23 to the unchanged public-path checks. Daniela records it separately from Helio admin proof; Ines suppresses connection prompts while proof is pending; Customer Success owns pending assistance; Owen evaluates answer distribution, assisted resolution, subsequent admission, and day-7 supported integration descriptively, without a causal claim. Existing boundaries remain unchanged: no silent exception for agency/external-admin, unresolved ownership, manual billing, import/migration, unsupported permissions, support-heavy setup, or other route-out conditions. Routed cases are not self-serve outcomes."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_143_03", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document clearly presents the matrix as the live Helio Start intake baseline on April 23, 2024, and explicitly avoids presenting it as the later or current intake path.

Each negative case must show that the applicant is not admitted when that input is absent or unsatisfied.
